### The Blessing and Curse of the Ark
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/blessing-and-curse-of-the-ark
Passage: 1 Chronicles 13:10
Points:
- Bringing the ark to Jerusalem acknowledged that David ruled in submission to God as Israel's true King.
- The chronicler highlighted postexilic priorities by emphasizing corporate worship and obedience to God's law.
- Israel's failure to follow scriptural instructions for transporting the ark resulted in divine judgment against Uzzah.
- God's holiness demands reverent worship, and good intentions do not justify ignoring His direct commands.
- The presence of the ark brought great blessing to the home of Obed-edom when received with honor.
